description: Implement S3 file storage for call recordings, import files, export files, and document attachments. Currently file storage is referenced but not implemented. Create lib/storage.ts with AWS S3 client, presigned URL generation, and local filesystem fallback for development. Add STORAGE_BUCKET is already in .env.example. Add AWS_REGION, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Update Recording model usage, import/export file handling.
steps: Add storage env vars to .env.example: AWS_REGION, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_S3_BUCKET, STORAGE_PROVIDER='s3' or 'local' (defaults to local in dev)
Update lib/env.ts: add AWS_REGION, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_S3_BUCKET as optional strings. Add STORAGE_PROVIDER enum.

Create lib/storage.ts: export interface StorageAdapter { uploadFile, downloadUrl, deleteFile, exists }. Implement S3Adapter using @aws-sdk/client-s3 and LocalAdapter using fs/promises. Export singleton storage instance based on STORAGE_PROVIDER env var. Include graceful error handling.

Create lib/storage/s3.ts: class S3Storage implements StorageAdapter. uploadFile(buffer, path, contentType) uploads to S3, returns key. getPresignedUrl(key, expiresIn) generates signed URL. deleteFile(key) removes object. Handle credentials from env.

Create lib/storage/local.ts: class LocalStorage implements StorageAdapter. uploadFile saves to public/uploads/ directory. downloadUrl returns /uploads/path. deleteFile removes file. Create uploads directory if missing.

Update services/call-service.ts: when call recording webhook received, use storage.uploadFile() to store recording, save storageKey to Recording table. When recordings accessed, use storage.getPresignedUrl(recording.storageKey) to generate download link.
Update app/api/leads/import/route.ts: upload CSV file using storage.uploadFile(), save key to ImportBatch. When processing completes, optionally delete file or keep for audit.

Update app/api/leads/export/route.ts and app/api/reports/[type]/export/route.ts: save generated Excel/PDF to storage instead of streaming directly. Return presigned download URL. Set 1-hour expiry. Clean up old exports with scheduled job.
Create app/api/storage/cleanup/route.ts: cron job endpoint to delete files older than 7 days from storage. Protect with CRON_SECRET.
Add storage health check to app/api/health/route.ts: test S3 connection by calling headBucket or similar
Write tests in tests/storage.test.ts: test upload/download/delete for both S3 and local adapters, test presigned URL generation, test graceful fallback
Update DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md: document S3 bucket setup (create bucket, configure CORS, create IAM user with PutObject/GetObject/DeleteObject permissions)
acceptance_criteria: Call recordings stored in S3 (or local in dev) with presigned download URLs
Import files saved to storage for audit trail
Export files saved to storage and cleaned up after 7 days
Local storage works in development without AWS credentials
S3 storage works in production with proper credentials
Storage failures don't crash the application (graceful error messages)
Presigned URLs expire after specified time
verification: npm run test - storage tests pass for both adapters
Start app with STORAGE_PROVIDER=local - upload import file - verify saved to public/uploads/
Start app with STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3 and valid AWS credentials - upload file - verify in S3 console
Make a call with recording (or simulate) - verify recording stored and downloadable
Export leads to Excel - verify file uploaded to storage and download link works
Wait 1 hour - verify download link expired (403 error)
Run cleanup cron - verify old files deleted
